title: Disappointed
text: Disappointed. We put the tree in the bag and tried to put it away but the handles started ripping and where the wheels connect to the bag ripped as well.  We had to get the dolly. Bag is not durable at all. Would not recommend.

product_metadata.title: Christmas Tree Storage Bag - Stores a 9-Foot Artificial Xmas Holiday Tree. Durable Waterproof Material to Protect Against Dust, Insects, and Moisture. Zippered Bag with Carry Handles. (Red)
features: Stores a 9-foot disassembled, artificial Christmas tree, garland, and even lights.
Extra-large, heavy-duty tarp material is designed to be strong, durable, and tear-resistant.
Protects a Christmas tree against dust, insects, and moisture, so it can last for many years.
The roomy, zippered bag is 65 inches long by 15 inches wide by 30 inches high.
There are two heavy-duty reinforced handles on each side for carrying and another loop for pulling.
